## Sheet P1 — Heo Ngư Dân, Heo Mỹ Nhân Ngư, Heo Poseidon, Heo Làm Vườn, Heo Dâu, Heo Bắp

- Lưu thành: `art_inbox/.batch/farm-02-pigs/P1.png`
- Đính kèm (theo thứ tự): `1_style_creature.png`
- Kết quả: lưới 2×3: pig_fisherman, pig_mermaid, pig_poseidon, pig_gardener, pig_strawberry, pig_corn

```text
Image 1 is the STYLE REFERENCE: finished art from my game. Copy its art style exactly: a dark warm-brown outline (never black) of even weight, soft cel shading with one shadow tone and one highlight tone, light from the top-left, warm pastel colours of medium saturation, a subtle painted texture, rounded chunky friendly shapes, low-to-medium detail. Do NOT copy the objects of image 1.

Draw ONE image: a sheet of 6 separate game sprites in a clean grid of 2 row(s) x 3 column(s), in exactly this order, left to right, top to bottom:
Row 1: (1) Fisherman Pig: wearing a Vietnamese conical straw hat (non la) and a blue sleeveless vest, holding a short bamboo fishing rod with a tiny fish on the line; (2) Mermaid Pig: the front half a pink pig with a seashell hair clip and pearl necklace, the back legs replaced by a turquoise fish tail with soft fins, sitting on its tail; (3) Poseidon Pig: a sea-king pig with a small gold crown, a sea-green toga over one shoulder, a curly white beard and a small golden trident.
Row 2: (1) Gardener Pig: wearing green overalls and a wide straw sun hat with a daisy, holding a small green watering can; (2) Strawberry Pig: a pig coloured strawberry-red with tiny cream seed dots on its body and a green leafy strawberry-calyx cap on its head; (3) Corn Pig: a buttery-yellow pig wearing a hood of green corn-husk leaves, a corn-silk tuft on top and a kernel pattern on its back.
Every character is the SAME chubby chibi pig body as the pink pig in image 1: round pink body, big head, short stubby legs, curly tail, round snout, small dot eyes with a white highlight, rosy cheeks. The theme is shown by costume, colour and one small prop only; the pig body and proportions never change.
Body in side view facing RIGHT, head turned slightly toward the viewer (three-quarter head), standing calmly, all feet on one invisible ground line.

Every object is fully visible and centred in its own cell, with wide empty gaps between objects; nothing touches, overlaps or crosses into another cell. Wide landscape image.
Background: one plain flat light-grey colour (#C8C8C8) everywhere. No gradient, no texture, no floor, no cast shadow on the background.
No text, letters, numbers, labels, captions, watermark, logo, border or frame. Not glossy, not a 3D render, not flat vector, not pixel art. No glow, no sparkles, no floating particles.
```
